content: <thought>To construct the target in a single step, a Suzuki‑Miyaura cross‑coupling between a vinyl bromide (or iodide) bearing the phenyl group and a cyclobutanol‑CF₃ boronic acid is appropriate. I will locate a suitable Suzuki template, then verify that the two precursors—(E)-1‑bromo‑2‑phenylethene (SMILES: BrC=CC1=CC=CC=C1) and 3,3,3‑trifluoro‑cyclobutan‑1‑ol‑boronic acid (SMILES: C1CCC(C(F)(F)F)(O)C1B(OH)2)—are commercially available and inexpensive.
